verdict.rationale: New Relic documents NerdGraph, its public GraphQL API, for querying New Relic data and configuring features, and offers an API explorer for trying it out, so the core of the story is delivered. The docs themselves say only "some" features can be configured through it, and the evidence shows no auth, rate-limit or full reference detail. The OpenAPI probe 404s, which fits a GraphQL API and does not contradict it. Missing for 10: evidence the API covers all product features, documented auth and rate limits, independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: NerdGraph is our GraphQL-format API that lets you query New Relic data and configure some New Relic features.
An easy way to experiment with the NerdGraph API is to use the NerdGraph API explorer.
